instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use first candidate (no ranking)

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")

The yellow_pen must be picked up from its current location before being placed in the green_case.
The robot must verify that the green_case is accessible and not obstructed.
task_spec.refined_instruction: First, confirm that the green_case is empty and accessible. If the green_case is occupied, clear it by removing any object currently inside.
